title: TO MY FELLOW TRADERS
author: junior7_7
selftext:
Hi, I’m Destiny, a 19year old trader from Nigeria. I’ve been day trading for over 2 years, but progress has been slower than I’d hoped. I currently have no funded or live account, not because I’ve blown them but because I haven’t had any opportunity to prove my skill..I’ve blown 3 funded accounts, passed 1 ($5k CFD), and made 2 payouts last year totaling around $300.

Right now, I’m in university and money is tight. Jobs here often pay as little as $50 a month for long hours, so I’m looking for a remote side hustle to help me earn extra income and fund my trading journey.

I can help with Discord server setup, clip farming, basic online tasks, and more. If you know of any remote opportunities or need assistance with something, I’d really appreciate it. My goal is simply to earn enough to afford funded accounts and continue proving my skills as a trader. Thank you. My discord username is ( junior7.11 )
